profiles.name: xredis_command
profiles.description: Only command encoding and required core closure

profiles.name: xredis_reader
profiles.description: Only incremental reply parsing and required core closure

profiles.name: xredis_reply
profiles.description: Owned replies and reader/atomic/number_float closure, excluding networking and executors

profiles.name: xredis_client
profiles.description: TCP requests and bounded connection initialization with public core closure, excluding TLS, HTTP, Dial and task executors

profiles.name: xredis_dial
profiles.description: Optional hostname/resolved-endpoint setup and XRT Resolver/Dial closure; excludes TLS, HTTP, WebSocket and task executors

profiles.name: xredis_tls
profiles.description: Verified TLS client/records/session plus existing NetDial, excluding HTTP/WebSocket/task executors, extra TLS-Dial wrappers and fixture RSA identity creation

profiles.name: xredis_tls_auth
profiles.description: Native client certificate authentication; private signing backends and fixture process launcher remain separate

profiles.name: xredis_transaction
profiles.description: Managed atomic transaction runtime; optional DNS/TLS/private signer/process/HTTP runtimes excluded

profiles.name: xredis_watch
profiles.description: Exclusive WATCH/read/decision/commit scopes on the existing client; DNS/TLS/signers/process/HTTP remain optional

profiles.name: xredis_pool
profiles.description: Fixed-membership exclusive lease pool with hard aggregate physical command quotas; optional DNS/TLS/private signer/process/HTTP runtimes excluded
